evidence_classification_taxonomy.official_current: Current first-party Lazada evidence checked at the recorded time and bounded by country, mode, permission and validity.
evidence_classification_taxonomy.verified_software_observation: Directly observed T One, browser, API, test or runtime input/output; it proves only the observed software state.
evidence_classification_taxonomy.multi_source_practice: A practice hypothesis supported by at least three independent sources and not contradicted by current official evidence.
evidence_classification_taxonomy.single_case: One dated seller, blogger, forum or operator case; experiment hypothesis only.
evidence_classification_taxonomy.historical_trace: A dated prior operation or legacy record retained for provenance, not current platform truth.
evidence_classification_taxonomy.unknown: Evidence is missing, blocked, stale or too weak to classify more strongly.

Finance reads remain country-store scoped; transaction detail, payout status, bank receipt and ERP/operator reconciliation are separate states.

AI Smart Listing, optimization, visual editing and translation outputs remain drafts until live leaf-schema, product-fact, rights, localization and human approval checks pass.
Lazzie Seller and Business Advisor provide advice or scoped analytics; neither authorizes listing, price, inventory, promotion or campaign changes.
LISA configuration and automated buyer replies require country-account eligibility, exact source facts, audit/recovery controls and explicit owner approval.

LISA size charts, knowledge, keywords, handoff and reports remain country-store and product scoped; public training does not establish entitlement or live results.
Official GitHub identity requires a reverse link from an official platform source; organization names, stars and search rank are insufficient.
An official repository must still prove Lazada relevance, license, security, maintenance, data boundary and non-duplication before adoption.
Comments are anonymized community signals or dated cases and never override official current policy without verification.
Public course cards and authentication redirects do not establish course access, wallet, campaign or Sponsored Solutions capability.
Marketplace, LazMall and LazGlobal are country registration or program labels until an authorized store identity resolves them; SEA remains non-executable.
An official social reverse link validates channel provenance, not the current policy status of every video.
MCL enrollment, inbound, inventory, pick, pack, dispatch, carrier handoff and delivery are separate evidence states; public marketing completes none for a specific object.
PH FBL and country logistics presence do not prove PH MCL availability; keep the public five-country MCL page and the sponsored six-country claim as an unresolved dated conflict.
MCL one consolidated stock never creates one executable SEA inventory; retain country, seller, store binding, program enrollment, warehouse, sales channel, SKU and inventory ownership.
Air-conditioned or fenced storage examples are category-sensitive facility signals, not universal SKU eligibility or product acceptance.
Sponsored MCL growth and volume figures are dated marketing evidence, not policy, SLA, forecast, guarantee or seller-specific results.
A fully reviewed public social post with zero comments yields zero comment clusters and no identity, entitlement or operating-state promotion.
A community URL blocked before its body is opened_not_reviewed; search summaries cannot substitute for post or comment evidence.

A package license, release, CI, stars, README or unit test does not establish a connected Lazada capability; admission requires secure review, exact country seller identity, endpoint-contract tests and an owner-authorized scoped read.

Unofficial Lazada clients must fail closed on a missing country and bind credentials to country_user_info seller_id, short_code and T One store_binding; VN fallback, ALL routes and shared default token keys are forbidden.
Reject any client that disables TLS verification or can log secrets, tokens, signatures or signed URLs, regardless of license or release recency.
A two-endpoint SG probe or a test harness that can return before its runner cannot prove six-country, endpoint, refresh, pagination or failure-recovery coverage.

continuous_training.source_diversity_policy: one official primary plus at least one community, public-video or GitHub category per evidence-bearing round; single anecdotes stay dated hypotheses
continuous_training.fingerprint_policy: skip unchanged canonical URL/title/date/hash; retain version and conflict relationships
continuous_training.deep_coverage_policy: record identity/date/version/site, section and end-state coverage, expansions, relevant links, applicable pagination, comment/reply scope and inaccessible areas before distillation
continuous_training.comment_policy: inspect pinned, high-ranked, recent, author or official replies and disputes where supported; anonymize clusters, filter spam and keep comments below official rules

hard_review_policy.webpage: at least 90 percent measured scroll coverage plus footer, navigation or directory, applicable pagination or related page and a necessary second-level page or recorded second-level access failure
hard_review_policy.infinite_scroll: observe at least three new-load cycles and record the stop reason
hard_review_policy.video_under_ten_minutes: at least 95 percent playback or transcript coverage plus key-frame review; otherwise opened_not_reviewed
hard_review_policy.video_over_ten_minutes: complete transcript or chapters plus start, three core-section and end checks; if reliable transcript is absent, play completely
hard_review_policy.comments: sample at least 10 comments or all available across pinned/high-ranked/recent/author-reply/objection/failure views; record explicit zero when none exist

continuous_training.logged_in_browser_policy: reuse only the owner-authorized current Chrome session through the supported interface; never export credentials, cookies or tokens and stop at login, MFA, CAPTCHA, payment or access-control boundaries
continuous_training.github_identity_policy: official organization identity requires a reverse link from an official platform source; dedupe owner/repo plus release or commit before review and never auto-install

knowledge_package_policy.required_sample: one core workflow, one boundary or failure and three key rules plus observable test-entrypoint tracing
knowledge_package_policy.admission_gate: secure defaults plus exact country seller identity plus endpoint method/path/body/signature/response contract plus one owner-authorized scoped read
knowledge_package_policy.installation_boundary: do not clone, install, run or copy unaudited packages

rules.rule: Lazada Affiliate identity, scopes and results are separate from seller-center, logistics, ads and store-operation identities.
Link created, HTTP 200, product page reachable, buyable, affiliate-attributed, converted and settled are distinct states with separate evidence.
Reject connectors that disable TLS verification, accept arbitrary fetch URLs, automate account cookies or commit credentials.
Evidence from MY or TH never establishes behavior across all Lazada Southeast Asian country sites; each country and store is verified separately.
Configuration files and tests without assertions do not prove signing, token refresh, country routing, pagination, idempotency or business completion.
A public repository license does not grant rights to an unreviewed closed hosted service, and a third-party seller identifier is observation rather than store authorization.
